= Result variables
:page-toclevels: 2
:description: Variables available in result expressions (plots, datasets, derived values)

Variables available in result expressions (plots, datasets, derived values). A variable is listed in the GUI only when the solution contains it.

== Short names

These short names are accepted in result expressions as well:

* `+mises+` = `+solid.mises+`
* `+disp+` = `+solid.disp+`
* `+normE+` = `+es.normE+`
* `+normJ+` = `+ec.normJ+`
* `+normB+` = `+mf.normB+`
* `+U+` = `+spf.U+`
* `+p_re+` = `+acpr.p_t+`
* `+Lp+` = `+acpr.Lp+`
* `+abs_p+` = `+acpr.absp+`
* `+Qrh+` = `+ec.Qrh+`
* `+tflux+` = `+ht.tfluxMag+`
* `+phil+` = `+cd.phil+`

== Unit families

A plot or evaluation can show a quantity in any unit of its family (the *Unit* list next to the expression):

* `+K+`, `+degC+`, `+degF+`
* `+Pa+`, `+kPa+`, `+MPa+`, `+GPa+`, `+bar+`, `+psi+`
* `+m+`, `+cm+`, `+mm+`, `+um+`, `+nm+`
* `+V+`, `+mV+`, `+kV+`
* `+V/m+`, `+kV/m+`, `+V/mm+`, `+kV/mm+`
* `+m/s+`, `+mm/s+`, `+cm/s+`, `+km/h+`
* `+W/m^2+`, `+kW/m^2+`, `+W/cm^2+`, `+mW/m^2+`
* `+A/m^2+`, `+A/mm^2+`, `+kA/m^2+`, `+MA/m^2+`
* `+T+`, `+mT+`, `+uT+`, `+G+`
* `+W/m^3+`, `+kW/m^3+`, `+MW/m^3+`, `+W/cm^3+`, `+W/mm^3+`
* `+mol/m^3+`, `+mmol/m^3+`, `+mol/L+`, `+mmol/L+`
* `+J/m^3+`, `+kJ/m^3+`, `+mJ/m^3+`
* `+C/m^2+`, `+uC/m^2+`, `+nC/m^2+`
* `+A/m+`, `+kA/m+`
* `+Wb/m+`, `+mWb/m+`

== Color tables

`+Rainbow+`, `+RainbowLight+`, `+Thermal+`, `+ThermalLight+`, `+Wave+`, `+WaveLight+`, `+Cyclic+`, `+GrayScale+`, `+Traffic+`, `+Jupiter+`, `+Prism+`.
